_meta.notes: TWO FIGURES ARE RECORDED PARTIAL (dollars only, cents NOT completed) because their raised-cents superscripts are written over an earlier value and are genuinely illegible even at 300 dpi with the cell enlarged: Line 3 Column A ('8,616' + an overwritten two-character superscript) and Line 1 Column B ('$93,512' + an overwritten superscript that could be 50 or 55). I did NOT fill the cents in from arithmetic, though note that Line 4 is 49,961.00 and Line 5 is clearly 58,577.50, which would put Line 3 at .50. The rest of the page is legible. The form's own arithmetic is off by $0.50 at the bottom: 58,577.50 - 50,279.59 = 8,297.91, but Line 7 prints 8,297.41 (Line 6's superscript looks like '51' where Line 2 reads '.59' — another overwrite). Column B also does not reconcile with Column A. Neither amendment box is checked. Top-row Office reads 'County Council #3', party abbreviated 'D'. Stamped RECEIVED OCT 26 2010.
